description: Portable automatic data processing machines, weighing not more than 10 kg, consisting of at least a central processing unit, a keyboard and a display
rationale: Finished laptops, notebooks and tablet computers; same HTS6 line as the original baseline. Tablets cannot be separated at any level: the current HTS has one HTS8 line (8471.30.01) and one HTS10 line (8471.30.01.00) under 8471.30 (checked 2026-11-06), so the product is laptops and tablets together. HTS continuity 2017-2026 has not been checked against archived HTS editions, so the approval card says continuity is unverified.

description: Parts and accessories of the machines of heading 8471
rationale: Parts and accessories are inputs, not finished laptops; research them as a separate scope if needed.

description: Other automatic data processing machines comprising in the same housing at least a central processing unit and an input and output unit
rationale: Desktop and all-in-one computers share heading 8471 but are a different product.
